missing_claims.claim: The published CEL-Seq2 library PCR primer bases are unavailable.
missing_claims.evidence: Two independent source reads confirm author protocol MOESM4 names RP1/RPIX and original Illumina table lines 180-198 prints their family bases. Exact chosen index tube is separate.

conclusion: The RP1/RPIX family is source-positive; the current official Illumina table provides representative RPI1 but does not establish the 2016 run-specific index tube. MOESM5/MOESM6 identities were corrected and the earlier false two-pass row was archived. All six original attachments and the linked vendor table now have two located readings. Historical index choice and kit revision remain unresolved.
